correctness.rationale: Greedy waiting times for a fixed string are independent geometric variables by independence of the unread input; the stopping time tests occurrence, not multiplicity of embeddings. The angular constant term enforces exactly q-1 independent Parikh equalities. Strict positivity at consecutive waiting-time degrees rules out a second radial phase at |z|=r, and full support with the last angle fixed forces all angles to be zero in the angular equality case. At the pole in t=z/r the radial derivative is 2 mu, and the quadratic angular defect is theta^T C theta with C=diag(v_1,...,v_{q-1})-vv^T and det C=product v_a. The implicit root is real locally, with log t(theta)=theta^T C theta/(2 mu)+O(|theta|^4). On a fixed sufficiently small angular neighborhood a common circle just outside the roots gives the single residue and a uniform exponentially small remainder; a possibly smaller outside circle works for the complementary compact angular set. Gaussian integration and the analytic factor 1/(1-rt) give the stated constant. Summing unrestricted patterns instead gives U/(1-U); its simple residue gives the ratio of means. In the binary case the cosine integral yields the stated discriminant, and direct algebra gives r=1/(1+s), v_0 v_1=s/(1+2s), mu=2(1+s)/(1+2s). Uniform substitution agrees as well. It quantifies that balance can cost a power for each independent coordinate without altering the exponential base, and specifies the sensitivity to every fixed letter mass.
